about_the_game:
Purr Plate – Craft Your Wholesome Feline Picnic Paradise!

Come and build your dream Purr Plate!
"In this sunlit feline paradise, become the owner of a one-of-a-kind restaurant designed with your dream 'Purr Plate'! Team up with over 100 quirky cat staffers - from paw-kneading bakers to servers tumbling adorably over their own tails - to create your purrfect woodland café."

Craft Your Whimsical Haven
Start from scratch using 50+ modular components:
🐾 Combine rustic log kitchens with floating cloud-shaped dining platforms
🐾 Design enchanted garden nooks where fireflies illuminate heart-shaped scones
🐾 Build nap stations with dangling yarn balls for tired paws
Every moss-covered stone and mismatched teacup tells your unique story!

Core Gameplay:

 Staff with Character
Meet your unforgettable team:
• Grain – The chubby tabby who bakes at lightning speed...when not napping in flour sacks
• Spring – A hyperactive kitten delivering orders in 3 seconds flat (and breaking 2 plates)
• Scar – The rugged explorer who hunts rare mushroom ingredients between shifts

Stress-Free Strategy
Ditch spreadsheets! Our "Claw-culus" system lets you:
✓ Rotate seasonal menus by catching falling cherry blossoms
✓ Boost tips by assigning vocal cats to sing for customers
✓ Design obstacle courses to optimize serving routes

Forest of Whiskered Wonders
Send adventuring parties beyond the tea fields to:
• Decode recipes from a poetry-reciting owl
• Trade fish cookies with underground mole merchants
• Uncover why the river flows with lavender honey at midnight...

Breaking News!
Our first playable Demo will arrive soon!
Join our playtest event – let's build Purr Plate together!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-12100F / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 Super 4G / AMD RX 6500 XT 4G
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060Super 12GB / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
